# PLAN — iteration 5
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent is timing-feasible at 79 LUTs, 202 FFs and WNS 1.645 ns, so this iteration must strictly reduce LUTs (or tie LUTs and reduce FFs) to improve the `minimize_luts` objective. The supplied seed uses a five-stage elastic pipeline and full-width 28-bit `sum2_*` registers; iteration 4’s narrower product-register proposal was rejected for increased LUT use. Preserve the top’s `// @latency 5`, defined transfer age, arithmetic, handshakes, reset behavior and all deterministic gates.

## Hypothesis
Narrowing only the four registered `sum2_*` pairwise sums to their exact coefficient-derived ranges may reduce adder and register-enable logic while keeping the DSP product mapping unchanged.

## Instruction for generator
Keep all `prod1_*` registers at 27 bits; do not repeat iteration 4’s product-register narrowing. Change `sum2_0`, `sum2_1`, `sum2_2`, and `sum2_3` to signed widths of 22, 23, 26, and 27 bits respectively, matching the exact bounds of `prod0+prod1`, `prod2+prod3`, `prod4+prod5`, and `prod6+prod7`, and explicitly sign-extend them into the existing downstream sums. Preserve the 28-bit exact accumulator and current elastic-stage enables, then judge the candidate against the incumbent using routed LUT/FF metrics and all fixed verification gates.
